spots.text: CATWALK INSPECTION. Rails: sound. Hangers: sound. Floor: see below.

secrets.name: The Maintenance Room
secrets.text: Under the crossing, behind what looks from the catwalks like one more hanging bookcase, is the room where somebody keeps the grid: a bench of tools, a cot, a kettle, a logbook. The last entry says: all rails sound.

meta.label: The Catwalks
meta.blurb: There is no floor. There is a grid of iron walkways, and bookcases hanging from them on rods, and a long way down, the sky.
